study_type_evidence.quote: Mice were administered with vehicle, LPS and/or Fc-ELA daily for five consecutive days.
The immortalized human proximal tubular epithelial cell lines HK-2 (ATCC CRL-2190, Manassas, VA) were grown in Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: female C57/BL6, 6 weeks old at receipt, used after 1 week of quarantine and acclimatization
in_vivo_species.quote: C57/BL6 female mice, at 6 weeks old, were obtained from Charles River (Wilmington, MA) and used after 1 week of quarantine and acclimatization.

in_vitro_detail: Human proximal tubular epithelial HK-2 cells (ATCC CRL-2190) treated with ELA-21 (2 μM) or Fc-ELA (2 or 5 μM) and/or LPS (2 μg/ml), with or without the PI3K/Akt inhibitor LY294002; endpoints were TUNEL apoptosis, DHE reactive oxygen species staining, Bax/Bcl-2 Western blotting and MTT cell viability.

agents.name: Fc-ELA-21 (Fc-ELA fusion protein)
agents.sequence_source: Body describes only that 'we fused the Fc domain of the human immunoglobulin IgG to ELA-21, resulting in Fc-ELA-21'; no one-letter sequence is printed
agents.chemical_identifier: made by conjugating the human IgG Fc fragment with ELA-21 at the N-terminus as previously described
agents.group_n: n = 8 (Fig. 1), n = 9 (Fig. 2 and Fig. 5), n = 5 (Fig. 3, Fig. 4, Fig. 6A/C/D, Fig. 7), n = 6 (Fig. 6B)
agents.group_n_quote: Data are expressed as mean + SE (n=8). *P<0.05, ***P<0.001 and n.s., no statistical significance.
agents.dose: 1 mg/kg/day for five consecutive days (in vivo); 2 μM or 0-5 μM in HK-2 cells
agents.dose_route_quote: The Fc-ELA group was treated with Fc-ELA (1 mg/kg/day), s.c. and PBS, i.p.
agents.half_life_matrix: plasma (species and matrix not specified in the sentence reporting the value)
agents.pk_quote: Fc-ELA-21 ... which has an extended plasma half-life of ∼44 h (vs.∼13 min of the native peptide) and is biologically active.
agents.pk_section: INTRODUCTION (value cited from the authors' prior work; also restated in DISCUSSION as 'Fc-ELA-21 (Fc-ELA) has an in vivo half-life of ∼44 h'). NO pharmacokinetic experiment was performed in this study.

concentration_time_figure.note: No figure in this paper plots plasma or tissue concentration, level or percentage remaining against time. All figures show endpoint measurements (gene expression, creatinine, histology, DHE fluorescence, TUNEL, Western blots, MTT viability) at a single terminal timepoint 6 h after the final of five daily injections.

bioanalytical_method: not reported for pharmacokinetics; Western blotting with an anti-ELA antibody (AbboMax) was used on kidney tissue and HK-2 cell lysates for protein expression, not for plasma peptide quantification
bioanalytical_quote: incubated overnight at 4°C with the following primary antibodies: Bcl-2, Bax (Cell Signaling, Danvers, MA, U.S.A.), ELA (AbboMax, San Jose, CA), or GAPDH
notes: This study performed NO pharmacokinetic experiment. The half-life values of ~44 h (Fc-ELA-21) and ~13 min (native ELA peptide) appear in the body (Introduction and Discussion) but are explicitly cited from the authors' earlier work, not measured here: 'Further studies show that Fc-ELA-21 (Fc-ELA) has an in vivo half-life of ∼44 h and can significantly improve heart function in a model of myocardial infarction'. No species, matrix, dose, route, sampling schedule, assay or n is given for those half-life values in this body text, and no kinetic phase is named, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and half_life_matrix records only 'plasma' as stated. No Cmax, tmax, AUC, clearance or volume of distribution is reported anywhere in the body. Fc-ELA-32 is mentioned in the Discussion as having been produced previously but was found to be cleaved and was not tested here, so it is not listed as an agent. ELA-14 and ELA-11 are named as presumed cleavage fragments but were not administered or tested. Amino acid sequences are not printed anywhere in the body.
